description: Defines a data model for remote notes (RemoteNote), a protocol for remote notes API interactions (RemoteNotesAPI), and a mock implementation (MockRemoteNotesAPI) for testing or placeholder purposes.

classes.name: MockRemoteNotesAPI
classes.description: A mock implementation of the RemoteNotesAPI protocol that provides placeholder methods for pulling and pushing notes.

methods.name: pullNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an array of RemoteNote objects from the remote backend. Currently returns an empty list as a placeholder.

methods.name: pushNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an array of RemoteNote objects to the remote backend. Currently a no-op placeholder.
